projects.name: Natural Language to SQL Chatbot
projects.summary: Built an NL-to-SQL chatbot that translates natural language questions into SQL, executes queries against Supabase PostgreSQL, and returns structured responses to the host website through webhook-based integration.
resume_bullets: Developed an NL-to-SQL chatbot integrated with website webhooks that converts natural language into SQL, executes queries in Supabase PostgreSQL, and combines relational results with embedded Pinecone vector retrieval to deliver grounded responses.
projects.purpose: Combined relational query execution with embedded Pinecone vector search to support grounded responses, strengthen semantic context retrieval, and improve the end-to-end self-service experience across web and data layers.
